name: Build A Factory!
desc:
Welcome to Build A Factory! Create and grow your own factory by turning blocks into items.  Build a tower from the items to discover new islands! 🏝️

How to play:
⛏️ Mine blocks to produce in your factory!
💰 Hire workers to turn the blocks into items!
☁️ Build your tower as high as possible!


🎁 Join the group for in-game rewards!

⌛ Premium players get more playtime rewards and doubled gem boost!

A TBlox Studios Mini Project!
